Re: Herrera v. Wyoming, No. 17-532 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I represent Petitioner in the above-captioned matter.  On behalf of both parties, 
I am writing to request an extension of the briefing schedule in this case, as follows: 

Respondent’s brief:

December 13, 2018

any additional information.
